# relative-path: bare relative paths with one short id segment among otherwise wordy segments,
# alone on their line with no key. the id segment is a real (non-secret) short identifier such as
# a task or branch id, e.g. from git branch names; sekretbarilo's own git-branch-per-task naming
# convention produces exactly this shape.
task/9zjEfcywkWlJ5QOj/integrator/lead
task/9zjEfcywkWlJ5QOj/main/unit/t3-engine
branch/9zjEfcywkWlJ5QOj/integrator/lead
ticket/9zjEfcywkWlJ5QOj/review/checklist
workspace/9zjEfcywkWlJ5QOj/release/notes
output/9zjEfcywkWlJ5QOj/deployment/summary
project/9zjEfcywkWlJ5QOj/validation/report
review/9zjEfcywkWlJ5QOj/platform/checklist
# known gap: a bare file name alone (e.g. background-execution.md) is not covered; deferred, it is
# lexically indistinguishable from a chunked-secret attack without more context and needs
# measurement on real payloads before being added.
# known gap: a relative path with two id segments is not covered (disqualified by design: more than
# one id-shaped segment is treated as ambiguous rather than as two ids).
# a keyed relative path is covered when every part between `/ . - _ + :` is a word, a number of at
# most eight digits or the one letter-and-digit part of at most eight bytes it may carry, and its
# leaf, read before a `:` suffix, is wordy.
model: provider/abc-5-large:medium
Evidence: .agent/tasks/ab-12345-run7-migration/02-summary
path: docs/plans/hud-refresh-flow.md
where: Sources/AppKit/WindowStore+Layout.swift:restoreFrame
where: Sources/Kit/QuickPanel+Keyboard.swift:handleKey
# known gap: a keyed relative path whose id segment is longer than eight bytes
# (e.g. `token = task/<16-byte id>/lead`) is reported; a key reduces confidence that a longer mixed
# segment is a harmless id.
# a keyed relative path reads a usage placeholder as the words it holds, and sets aside git's
# exclude magic before a pathspec and an English possessive after its leaf; a dated file name,
# `YYYY-MM-DD-` then words, needs no `/`, keyed or alone on its line.
usage: Tests/<ExampleClass>/<method_name>/fixtures.json
template: docs/<workspace>/<task-id>/manifest.md
exclude: ':!vendor/widget-toolkit/generated-bindings.json'
evidence: guides/widget-timeout-applies-per-phase.md's
source: tasks/review-widget-report-summary-message.md's
2026-09-14-widget-cache-enforces-minimum-lifetime.md
2026-07-04-release-planning-notes.md
plan: 2026-09-14-widget-cache-enforces-minimum-lifetime.md
notes: docs/plans/2026-09-10-docs-site-redesign.md
# known gap: a dated name whose words are all short (`2026-08-17-<five words of three to five
# letters>.md`) reads as a value cut into short groups and stays reported.
